definition.contrast: median over the AIMED box of |Lc - Lg| / (Lc + Lg)
definition.ground: the DARKER of the two strip medians, min(median of ground_l, median of ground_r) from the still's aim.json (the left and right tenth over the box's rows)
definition.luma: Rec.709 on 0-1, CaptureRig's scale (0.2126 R + 0.7152 G + 0.0722 B, bytes / 255)
definition.mask: mask_box pixels whose excess green G - 0.5*(R + B) is >= 0.06 on 0-1: the chlorine's own colour, so the night sky never joins the mask
definition.note: no min of gas and smoke: every still keeps its own numbers and its own bar
definition.rim: signed Michelson, max(0, (top - body) / (top + body)), of the mask's top 6 rows per column against the mask's middle rows
definition.rise_m: median over the columns within 0.05 of the frame width of the centroid x of (centroid y - the mask's top row) / px_per_m: how far the cloud's top edge stands above the ground line its middle sits on. Screen rise over a 30 m-deep field carries the field's depth as well as the card, so this is a baseline comparison against the same field and pose, not a physical height

contrast.why: a floor: the cloud may not read worse than the build before it

rim.why: outside the spread of three captures of the current build (max + spread + 0.02), on the signed rim: only a top brighter than the cloud's body counts as a lip

rise_m.why: outside the spread of three captures of the current build (max + spread + 0.02), on rise_m: the metres the cloud's top edge stands above the ground line its middle sits on, same field and same pose
